about: B107 (QA-296, QA-299, QA-300; C6.11, C7.7; P-319: data, never code): which box of a form takes an answer, and which part of a form a person writes by hand, each from the form's own printed words and scripts, cited (P-170). The configured checkpoint proposes each one as the author and a second person approves it (api/src/features/checkpoint/045-form-field-gates.ts, api/src/form-field-gates.ts); a release then carries it. A gate is a condition in the rules' own language on facts the shared library holds: the form field is written only while it holds, so a question whose every form field on a form is gated off is not asked for that form. The official files are the local copies under official-sources/ircc/ (manifest.json). Every entry is Sample, Unconfirmed: expert (AGENTS rule 4). Legal points: Unconfirmed: no counsel.

byHand.words: the designated individual is someone who will not act as your representative, so the case holds no such person: the applicant writes their name and contact details in parts 5 and 6 by hand
byHand.cite: canada.ca "Authority to Release Personal Information to a Designated Individual (IMM 5475)" (page-imm5475.html, downloaded 2026-10-19): "Use this form if you want to allow us to give your personal information, such as the status of your application, to someone who will not act as your representative." The form itself, p. 1: "However, they will not be a representative who can conduct business with CIC and CBSA on your behalf. If you wish to be represented, you must complete and submit form Use of a Representative (IMM 5476)." Read 7 Nov 2026.

gates.words: the immigration status in the current country of residence is Other
gates.cite: IMM 5257 (09-2023) p. 1, question 7, "Other" box of the status row ("If your immigration status is other, please give details"); the form's own Validate script (validateCOR): "if (oStatus.rawValue == "06" ){  //"06" is Other … } else { … if (!oOther.isNull){ … oStatus.rawValue = null;", so details beside any other status empty the required status box; the form's own message on it: "You entered information that is not required, please review"; the form's list of values for status: "Citizen" (01), "Permanent resident" (02), "Visitor" (03), "Worker" (04), "Student" (05), "Other" (06), "Protected Person" (07), "Refugee Claimant" (08), "Foreign National" (09). Read 9 Nov 2026.

gates.words: the purpose of the visit is Other
gates.cite: IMM 5257 (09-2023) Details of visit to Canada (the template's subform Page3, which starts a new page; the printed page number was not read here), question 1: "a) Purpose of my visit" and "b) Other" ("Question 1 B. If you replied Other to Question 1 A, please provide details."); the form's own Validate script (validateDetailsOfVisit): "if (oPurpose.rawValue == "03" ) {  //03 is LIC code other … } else{ //negative Case: if Other has a value and purpose is not other throw an error … if(!oOther.isNull){ … oPurpose.rawValue = null;", so details beside any other purpose empty the required purpose box (then: "-Details Of Visit- The following field must contain a value: 1a) Purpose of my visit"); the form's own message on it: "You entered information that is not required, please review"; the form's list of values for purpose (VisitPurposeList): "Business" (01), "Tourism" (02), "Short-Term Studies" (04), "Returning Student" (05), "Returning Worker" (06), "Super Visa: For Parents or Grandparents" (07), "Other" (03), "Family Visit" (08), "Visit" (13). Read 10 Nov 2026.

gates.words: the person answered Yes to Background Information question 2 a), 2 b) or 2 c)
gates.cite: IMM 5257 (09-2023) Background Information (the template's subform Page3, which starts a new page; the printed page number was not read here), question 2: "2 a) Have you ever remained beyond the validity of your status, attended school without authorization or worked without authorization in Canada?", "2 b) Have you ever been refused a visa or permit, denied entry or ordered to leave Canada or any other country?", 2 c) "Have you previously applied to enter or remain in Canada?", then "2 d) If you answered "yes" to 2a), 2b or 2C) please provide details."; the form's own Validate script (validateBackGroundInformation): "//Negative case: if notes has a value, make sure Yes has been clicked above somewhere if (!q2D.isNull && (q2A.rawValue == "N" && q2B.rawValue == "N"  && q2C.rawValue == "N" )){ … q2A.No.rawValue = null; q2A.Yes.rawValue = null;" (and the same for 2 b) and 2 c)), so details beside three No answers empty the three required Yes/No boxes; the form's own message on it: "You entered information that is not required, please review". Read 10 Nov 2026.
